## About
Dicky Smalls Auto, Body & Sales is an auto repair shop on Bacon Drive in Beltsville. We handle brakes, diagnostics, suspension, powertrain work, tires and alignment, tune-ups and Maryland State Inspection, plus specialty work like carbon blasting and bimmer pipe installation.
Our master technicians have decades of experience between them working on engines, transmissions and drivetrains. We install brake parts on any foreign make and model with genuine OEM parts, and a reviewer said we also work on domestic vehicles.
You can request an e-estimate online, schedule an appointment, and follow the status of your repair with our online tool. We're open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.

## Services
- Brake service: Brake pads, rotors and brake sensors installed on any foreign make and model, using genuine OEM parts.
- Computer and electrical diagnostics: Check engine or service engine soon light on? Bring it in and we'll track down the problem.
- Oil change and preventive care: Oil changes, fuel injection service and preventive transmission care.
- Powertrain repairs and service: Maintenance and repair for engines, transmissions and drivetrains.
- Suspension services: Control arms, shocks and struts, sway bar links and other suspension repairs.
- Tires and alignment: Tire mounting and balancing, plus wheel alignment.
- Tire Rack authorized installer: Order your tires from Tire Rack online and have them shipped straight to our shop.
- Carbon blasting and bimmer pipe installation: Specialty services for drivers who need more than routine maintenance.
- Maryland State Inspection: Get your Maryland State Inspection done at our Beltsville shop.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get an estimate before I bring my car in?
A: Yes. Send us information about your vehicle and what you need done through our e-estimate form, and we'll email you an estimate.

Q: Do you offer a loaner car?
A: Ask about loaner vehicle availability when you schedule your appointment.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, ask us about in-house financing when you call or stop by.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM and closed Saturday and Sunday.
